中文

体验优化
- 适配 **DSH desktop 0.2.3-alpha.2**：在隔离 profile 冷启动验证，插件行正常挂载、`/remote-tunnel/*` 正常应答、客户端 bundle 正常加载
- 宿主半不可用时，卡片、输入框状态条与面板直接说明是「路由未注册（404/405）」还是「鉴权不可用（503）」，不再只显示裸 HTTP 状态
- DSH peer 范围显式纳入 0.2.3 预发布线（`… || ^0.2.2-rc.1 || ^0.2.3-alpha.2`），普通 SemVer 的 peer 检查也能接受 0.2.3 预发布版

问题修复
- **修复 0.2.3 上全部 `/remote-tunnel/*` 返回 500**（`cannot get property "connection.authentication" without inject`）：改为经注入了 `connection` + `connection.authentication` 的子上下文读取 `connection.admit()`；旧版宿主没有该服务时行为不变
- 鉴权通道确实无法运行时返回 503 `E_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE` 并记录原因，不再 500，也不会静默放行（这些路由会发放携带一次性 token 的 URL）
- 路由注册失败或缺少 `webServer` 时不再静默：`/remote-tunnel/status` 暴露 `services.webServer` 与 `services.admission`，插件「active 但不可用」可以诊断
- 新增回归锁：客户端 bundle 永不读写 `__DSH_FILE_UPLOAD__`、不替换 `fileUpload` 服务、不覆写全局 `fetch`，从代码上保证不会复现另一个远程插件（ds-harness-remote #577）那种把本机图片上传一起打断的故障

其他变更
- 测试 52 → 57：新增 admission 注入作用域回归、503 路径、缺 `webServer` 上报，以及「不接管上传」静态锁

---

English

Improvements
- **DSH desktop 0.2.3-alpha.2 support**: verified in an isolated profile cold boot — the plugin row mounts, `/remote-tunnel/*` answers, and the client bundle loads
- When the host half is unavailable, the card, composer strip and pane now say whether the routes were never registered (404/405) or request admission is unavailable (503), instead of showing a bare HTTP status
- The DSH peer range names the 0.2.3 prerelease line explicitly (`… || ^0.2.2-rc.1 || ^0.2.3-alpha.2`), so plain SemVer peer checks accept DSH 0.2.3 prereleases too

Bug Fixes
- **Fixed every `/remote-tunnel/*` route answering HTTP 500 on 0.2.3** (`cannot get property "connection.authentication" without inject`): Connection is now read through a child context that injects `connection` + `connection.authentication`; older hosts without that service keep the previous behaviour
- A fence that genuinely cannot run is answered as 503 `E_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE` with the recorded reason — no more opaque 500, and no silent allow either (these routes hand out a URL carrying a one-time token)
- Route registration failure or a missing `webServer` is no longer silent: `/remote-tunnel/status` exposes `services.webServer` and `services.admission`, so an active-but-unavailable plugin is diagnosable
- Regression lock: the client bundle never touches `__DSH_FILE_UPLOAD__`, never replaces the `fileUpload` service and never patches global `fetch`, so this plugin cannot reproduce the local image-upload breakage reported against another remote plugin (ds-harness-remote #577)

Chores
- Tests 52 → 57: the admission-injection regression, the 503 path, missing-`webServer` reporting, and the "never take over uploads" static lock
